bull.b: The FY2026 rebound demonstrates substantial operating leverage as higher revenue translated into exceptionally strong profitability after several loss-making years. If demand remains supportive, this earnings base can fund technology investment, strengthen resilience, and improve the company’s ability to compete across higher-value storage markets.

Multi-year New Business Models create contractual revenue visibility and deepen strategic ties with Datacenter and Edge customers. Their expected mix above 50% of bits in FY2027 and roughly two-thirds in FY2028 should support a more predictable business profile while increasing exposure to expanding data-intensive workloads.

bull.t: Strong cash generation and conservative balance sheet
bull.b: Cash conversion closely tracking net income, combined with very low leverage, gives SanDisk meaningful financial flexibility. This supports capacity expansion, product development, and shareholder returns without relying heavily on borrowing, while the conservative balance sheet provides greater resilience when NAND conditions become less favorable.

bear.b: The sharp swing from losses and negative free cash flow to unusually high 2026 profitability shows that earnings remain highly sensitive to NAND pricing, demand, and industry conditions. This cyclicality can make results difficult to forecast and may reduce the durability of current margins if the favorable upcycle weakens.

The consumer decline indicates weakness in important PC and smartphone-related markets, reducing diversification while the company relies more heavily on datacenter growth. Management’s recovery expectation is deferred to 2027, so consumer softness could remain a drag on volumes and mix over the next several quarters.

A larger share of business tied to a few major customers can increase dependence on their spending plans, product adoption, and contractual decisions. Although financial guarantees provide protection, concentration may still amplify the impact of any customer-specific slowdown, renegotiation, or execution issue.
